name: Colored Stochastic Shadow Mapping for Volume Rendering
aliases: Colored Stochastic Shadow Mapping (CSSM) for Direct Volume Rendering
Stochastic Shadow Mapping for Volume Rendering
definition: A two-step rendering approach for direct volume rendering (DVR) that generates colored shadows using stochastic shadow maps. It adapts the CSSM concept (originally for surfaces) to volumetric data by modifying probabilistic events to represent photon traversal through a volume with changing opacities.
